item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Crispy fried pork belly with new potatoes and parsley sauce. Served with pickles on the side. (1+6)

item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Chicken souvlaki, Greek chicken skewers, with oregano and pepper roasted potatoes and pita bread. Served with tzatziki and a green Greek salad on the side. (1+6+7+15)
